text:
Type: large traditional area rug
Use: anchoring a living area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, classic
Materials: low pile woven fibers, fringed ends
Colors: burgundy red, warm tan, ivory, blue and green accents
Shape: large rectangle, central diamond medallion on tan field, red corners, wide decorative tribal border, fringe
Feel: warm, rich, inviting
Goes with: wood floors, light grey sofas, warm woods; traditional or eclectic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Regal Adornment Rug, 8' x 10', Burgundy
product.description: Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Cotton Imported This traditional-style rug features beautiful reds, blues and greens against a tan background. Made of materials designed to resist stains, fading and static, this rug looks vintage but is low maintenance and ideal for a busy room in your home. Classic style with modern materials Machine made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene. Classic, time-tested look with durability for high-traffic areas 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
